approach.heading: Frontend engineering, shaped by architecture.
approach.lead: I’m a frontend developer with a background in architectural engineering. I build React systems the way I was taught to read structures: reduce the span, make the load path visible, keep the exits obvious. The result is interfaces that are fast, accessible, and structurally sound.

facts.label: Approach
facts.value: Spatial systems, accessible from the start

principles.description: State is structural load. I place it where it bears least on the render path, and keep one source of truth per span.
A grid is an agreement, not a decoration. Tokens, spacing, and primitives create a geometry every screen inherits.
People enter, move, and exit. Focus order, landmarks, and motion preferences are the corridors of an interface.
